concepts.title: fable · Atlas
concepts.design_contract_summary: Settings as a well-edited reference manual: numbered sections, running header, status typeset as marginalia in a margin column, inline editing in the document, and managers relegated to appendices (Providers, Memory, MCP) cross-referenced from the taxonomy.

impacts.requirement: Packet section 01 mandates an 11-domain humanized taxonomy; canon (Plans/settings_inventory.json, pm.settings_inventory.v1, 825 settings, and PM7 PM_SETTINGS_DATA) is 12 categories x 3 subgroups keyed by dotted cat.sub.slug ids.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Atlas presents the 11 domains as numbered Parts with 3-5 subcategories each; canonical dotted ids are preserved and regrouped for display only (no id changes). Examples of display moves: general.visual.* into domain 2 Appearance & Layout; ai.models.* and ai.accounts.* into domain 3 Agents, Models & Accounts; safety.* into domain 4 Permissions & Safety; memory.* into domain 6 Context, Memory & History; branching.* into domain 8 Git, Worktrees & Crew; web.* and system.mcp.* into domain 9 Connections, Tools & Web.
supersedes_or_conflicts_with: 12x3 canon taxonomy as the display taxonomy
schema_or_event_impacts: Canon needs a display-taxonomy layer (domain/subcategory grouping) distinct from the id taxonomy, or a migration of ids.
demo_fixture_impacts: _shared/pm-demo-data.js taxonomy[] carries the 11-domain regrouping; settings map keeps canonical ids (110 src:inventory rows).
test_impacts: Deep links and search must resolve through the display taxonomy, not the id prefix.
notes: Regrouping is shared by all four concepts via _shared/pm-demo-data.js; recorded here because Atlas is the taxonomy-first concept.

impacts.requirement: Workspace navigation and appendix managers imply invocable actions (open a domain, jump to a subcategory, open an appendix manager, reveal a setting from search).
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Atlas implements directory-row activation, TOC-tree subcategory jumps via the shared scrollspy, inline See-Appendix cross-references, and search-result deep links that auto-expand advanced/diagnostic disclosures.
command_candidates_not_minted: settings: reveal setting (deep link, expands owning disclosure)
settings: open manager appendix (providers | memory | mcp)
notes: No command ids minted, per bakeoff rule.

impacts.requirement: Atlas's editorial devices must be portable to Slint 1.17.1.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Sticky running header inside the scroller; CSS-grid marginalia column; 40ms reading-order stagger capped at 8; smooth scroll + cached-offset scrollspy; narrow Contents drawer overlay; :empty::before prose placeholders.
slint_notes: position:sticky running header becomes a fixed header row above a Flickable bound to viewport offset.
Marginalia grid becomes GridLayout row templates with a fixed margin column.
Stagger becomes per-row sequenced opacity animations keyed by index; reduced motion is a single fade.
Scrollspy is already the documented viewport-offset to section-model mapping (cached offsets, no DOM geometry).
Narrow Contents drawer becomes a conditional layout swap plus popup layer on a width property.
:empty::before placeholder becomes the TextEdit placeholder property.
Atlas adds no backdrop-filter; glass flavor uses opaque elevated surfaces, keeping the shell's single allowed blur layer.

impacts.requirement: Staged state transitions (reconnect, refresh, invocation test) need a shared trigger/event surface covering every manager domain, not just providers.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: MCP server reconnect (Appendix C staged reconnect preserving the tool list) had to be staged locally in c1-atlas.js because PMState.trigger only targets providers; recorded as a shared-API gap.
command_candidates_not_minted: mcp: reconnect server (staged, preserves discovered tool list)
wiring_routes: MCP reconnect route emitting staged health transitions analogous to provider reconnect
schema_or_event_impacts: Trigger/event vocabulary needs an MCP scope (and plausibly LSP/media scopes) alongside provider-refresh/catalog-refresh/reconnect/invoke-test.
test_impacts: Reconnect-preserves-tool-list is a testable invariant once the shared trigger exists.

concepts.title: fable · Mission Control
concepts.design_contract_summary: Settings as an operational console: a persistent global health strip above every surface, a strictly ranked triage stack on Home, a right-edge proportional minimap as primary workspace navigation, and managers (Providers, Crew, Media) as the primary surfaces with plain settings in Configure drawers.

impacts.requirement: A live health strip and heat-marked minimap need derived, subscribable aggregates: provider readiness, worst usage pressure, notice counts, and per-row semantic states.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: The health strip chips are live navigation targets recomputed from store data on provider/catalog/scenario events; minimap heat comes from row semantics via PMState.resolveRowState, never DOM inspection. Store events currently rebuild the open console inspector, which closes an open effort/speed menu (state preserved, focus not) — real event granularity would need row-level patches.
wiring_routes: Derived health aggregates (readiness, pressure, notice counts) published as subscribable state
dry_component_candidates: Heat-marked proportional minimap driven by the scrollspy section registry
schema_or_event_impacts: Event granularity finer than whole-store rebuilds (row/inspector-level patches) to preserve open menus and focus.
test_impacts: Open-menu-survives-refresh becomes a testable requirement under finer events.
slint_notes: Minimap maps to a model-driven Rectangle column with y/height bindings against Flickable.viewport-y; drag writes viewport-y directly.

impacts.requirement: The command palette and console actions are natural command surfaces.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Ctrl/Cmd-K palette lists settings, actions, and managers with owner-category breadcrumbs and exposure labels; console toolbars expose Connect, Refresh catalog, Run invocation test, Reconnect; Crew exposes use-in-this-thread; Media exposes run-test-generation.
command_candidates_not_minted: providers: connect (cli | pm-direct oauth | api key | server)
providers: refresh catalog (preserve last known good)
crew: use template in this thread
notes: No command ids minted, per bakeoff rule.

impacts.requirement: Access-mode naming rule: modes are Full Access / Auto / Auto accept edits / Ask for approval; the string 'Yolo' must never appear in UI copy.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Plans/settings_inventory.json carries five 'YOLO' occurrences in access-mode copy; one sentence ('YOLO mode cannot skip this.') propagated into _shared/pm-demo-data.js during extraction. Fixed in the demo data during the folder verification pass ('No access mode can skip this.'); c2 additionally keeps a render-time sanitizer as defense-in-depth. The canonical inventory still carries the stale copy - recorded, not applied.
supersedes_or_conflicts_with: Inventory description copy for the always-ask-publish setting
demo_fixture_impacts: _shared/pm-demo-data.js needs the sentence removed; render-time sanitizer in c2 is a stopgap.
test_impacts: Source grep for 'Yolo'/'YOLO' should be part of the folder test pass.
notes: The demo-data key carrying the sentence is the publish-approval row; exact canonical id in the inventory should be confirmed by the fix task.

impacts.requirement: Console instrumentation must be portable to Slint 1.17.1.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Minimap geometry from the scrollspy registry, region-scoped refresh shimmer, palette and bottom-sheet overlays, scrollIntoView row centering, color-mix glass tints, and a web-only content-blocker fallback loader.
slint_notes: Shimmer becomes a static 'Refreshing — showing last known good' badge (already the reduced-motion end state) or a Timer-driven opacity pulse.
Palette/bottom-sheet become PopupWindow overlay layers with explicit focus scopes.
scrollIntoView(block:center) becomes row offset from the cached section model + animated viewport-y.
color-mix() tints become precomputed rgba brush tokens per theme.
The inline content-blocker fallback loader (XHR + eval) is web-only defensive code; not ported.

concepts.title: fable · Focus Stack
concepts.design_contract_summary: Settings as layered attention: one live surface at a time on a visible, poppable layer spine; disclosure is navigation (every advanced view, confirmation, and setup flow is a pushed sheet); near-empty Home; Personas and Terminal managers explore depth as meaning. Lowest density of the four.

impacts.requirement: Disclosure-as-navigation requires a first-class navigation stack: push/pop routes for advanced half-sheets, expert confirm sheets, details, capability evidence, requested-vs-effective explanations, and free-route setup, with search deep links auto-pushing the owning sheet.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: The layer spine models Home > Category > Manager/Sheet with a depth counter; PMSpy.reveal targets hidden exposures by pushing the Advanced/Diagnostics half-sheet before focusing the row (verified on ai.usage.monthly-spend-limit); every expert change pushes its own Confirm sheet.
command_candidates_not_minted: settings: push advanced sheet for subcategory
wiring_routes: Navigation back-stack with typed sheet kinds (category, manager, advanced, confirm, details, setup)
test_impacts: Deep links to advanced/diagnostic exposures must verify the sheet auto-push path.

impacts.selected_concept_behavior: c3 clamps long row descriptions at two lines (-webkit-line-clamp) with the full text one tap away in the details sheet — a deliberate editorial choice, but a strict reading of the rule may object.
test_impacts: Clip checks should distinguish accidental clipping from designed max-lines elision with a full-text affordance.
slint_notes: -webkit-line-clamp maps to max-lines text elision.

impacts.requirement: Glass themes allow at most one backdrop-filter layer anywhere on the page.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: The shared shell title bar (pm-shell.css) carries the one allowed blur; c3's topmost sheet also carries blur in glass themes, so the page totals two blur layers. c3 enforces topmost-only within its own layers; if the one-layer rule is absolute, the shell or the sheet must yield.
test_impacts: Glass-theme pass should count blur layers page-globally, not per-component.
slint_notes: Slint fallback is pre-composited translucency for the topmost sheet; lower layers are already opaque dimmed rectangles.

impacts.requirement: Spatial-continuity motion and stacked-surface input isolation must be portable.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Origin-anchored slide+scale push/pop, vertical-rl spine labels, element.inert on non-top layers, scrollend settle detection, terminal live preview via styled spans, first-class reduced-motion mode with identical end states.
slint_notes: Push/pop transitions become x/scale/opacity property animations; reduced motion collapses to instant swaps via the global switch.
writing-mode: vertical-rl becomes rotated Text elements inside TouchAreas.
element.inert becomes input disabled on lower layers in the component tree.
scrollend/idle settle becomes Flickable animated viewport-y with an explicit settle callback.
Terminal preview becomes a fixed sample buffer rendered by the real terminal component.

concepts.title: fable · Ledger
concepts.design_contract_summary: Settings as an object browser: every setting and manager object is a read-only record; all editing happens in a persistent inspector with provenance chain, requested-vs-effective diffs, and capability evidence; the navigator is a persistent query bar with state chips; zero animation by design. Highest density of the four.

impacts.requirement: The packet's per-setting state model exceeds canon: canon has tier simple|advanced and status{state,note}; the packet needs value source, exposure level, effective-vs-requested, scope notes, managed/unavailable reasons, risk notes, and cost/privacy/restart flags.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: The shared dataset (rendered most completely by Ledger's inspector) adds valueSource (default|custom|inherited|auto|managed|recommended|not-configured), exposure (standard|advanced|expert|managed|diagnostic|unavailable; 86/37/2/3/3/2 across 133 rows), effective vs value, scope + scopeNote, managedReason/unavailableReason/riskNote, and flags. 23 packet-required rows carry src:packet-2026-08-05 because no inventory id exists (spellcheck block, thread overrides, access-mode radio, cross-project policies, concurrency pair).
supersedes_or_conflicts_with: status{state,note} as the only state field
schema_or_event_impacts: New per-setting fields: valueSource, exposure, effective, scopeNote, managedReason, unavailableReason, riskNote, flags{restart,reconnect,cost,privacy,safety,perf}.
Capability evidence records {cap, state x7, source, at} on models.
23 new settings need minted canonical ids before promotion.
demo_fixture_impacts: _shared/pm-demo-data.js is the reference fixture: 110 rows src:inventory, 23 rows src:packet-2026-08-05.
test_impacts: Nine value-state rendering and requested-vs-effective diffs become testable invariants via PMState.resolveRowState.

impacts.requirement: The query engine and inspector imply invocable filters and record actions.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: Persistent query bar plus four state chips (Managed / Differs from default / Unavailable / Attention) filter navigator and document; the inspector exposes reset-to-default, expert unlock+confirm, and record actions; a Matches-elsewhere panel deep-links across views.
command_candidates_not_minted: settings: filter by state (managed | differs | unavailable | attention)
context: show admitted and omitted for last turn
schema_or_event_impacts: State-chip filtering needs queryable state facets on manager objects too; c4 only approximates these via data-states attributes today.
notes: No command ids minted, per bakeoff rule.

impacts.requirement: Packet forbids a universal budget / when-usage-runs-out setting; exhaustion behavior must be provider-specific whatNext options.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: The inventory's ai.usage.monthly-spend-limit is kept as an advanced spend guard (and is the standard search deep-link test target across concepts) while exhaustion behavior lives per-provider in the manager. Whether the global limit survives, becomes derived, or is retired is a canon decision.
supersedes_or_conflicts_with: ai.usage.monthly-spend-limit as a universal exhaustion control
notes: A spend cap is arguably distinct from a when-budget-runs-out behavior control; graded medium pending a canon reading.

impacts.requirement: The record/inspector grammar repeats across the provider manager, Context & Instructions, and Skills/Plugins/Tools, and should be one component family if promoted.
impacts.selected_concept_behavior: One grammar renders all record classes: record row (read-only, state chips), inspector (control + provenance chain default>global>project>thread + diffs + evidence + reset + caution gating), funnel table (installed>project-enabled>available>selected>invoked), and the sortable lazy-paged home table.
dry_component_candidates: Provenance chain display (default > global > project > thread)
slint_notes: Three-region grid becomes a HorizontalLayout of panels with conditional popup layers at narrow widths.
Sticky table headers render outside the ListView viewport.
withInstantMotion is a web-only trick; Slint sets viewport-y directly.
Zero-animation design makes c4 the lowest-risk Slint port and the motionless proof of the system.

cross_concept_findings.finding: Single shared semantics layer, per-concept presentation
cross_concept_findings.detail: PMState.resolveRowState (nine value states), PMState.resolveNotice (notice anatomy), and the provider 15-state matrix are resolved once in _shared/pm-state.js and rendered four different ways. If any concept is promoted, these resolvers are the DRY seeds: setting row resolver, notice anatomy, provider state matrix, scrollspy section-registry store, spellcheck service, States/scenario drawer.

cross_concept_findings.finding: Scrollspy as the portable navigation contract
cross_concept_findings.detail: All four concepts drive navigation (tree ink dot, minimap, outline chip, navigator marker) from PMSpy's cached-offset section registry with deadband hysteresis and programmatic-scroll suppression — never ad-hoc DOM geometry. This is directly the Slint Flickable viewport-offset mapping.

Resolved during folder verification: the banned sentence inherited from inventory copy was corrected in _shared/pm-demo-data.js ('No access mode can skip this.'). The upstream conflict lives in Plans/settings_inventory.json (five 'YOLO' occurrences) - recorded, not applied.

cross_concept_findings.finding: Taxonomy and schema deltas are shared, not per-concept
cross_concept_findings.detail: The 11-domain regrouping of canonical dotted ids, the six exposure levels replacing tier simple|advanced, valueSource/effective fields, and the 23 packet-sourced settings without inventory ids all live in _shared/pm-demo-data.js and affect every concept identically.

Transient staged transitions cover providers only (provider-refresh, catalog-refresh, reconnect, invoke-test); MCP reconnect required a local staging fallback in c1. Canon event vocabulary should scope triggers per manager domain.

cross_concept_findings.finding: LSP is the one unclaimed group-B manager
cross_concept_findings.detail: Manager coverage: Memory + MCP (c1), Crew + Media (c2), Personas + Terminal (c3), Context & Instructions + Skills/Plugins/Tools (c4). LSP exists in shared demo data but no concept builds its surface.

No real OAuth/CLI sign-ins, installs, purchases, provider calls, or credential storage anywhere; every unrunnable action returns a labeled PMState.receipt; persistence is confined to the pm.settingsConcepts.fable.* localStorage namespace.

cross_concept_findings.finding: Commands & shortcuts manager added during the compliance pass
cross_concept_findings.detail: Packet 04 requires commands search/shortcuts/conflicts/remapping/reset/custom lifecycle. Built ledger-native in c4 (filterable table, conflict + resolution note, inspector-side Remap/Reset receipts, custom-command lifecycle) and registered in the shared manager index so search reaches it from every concept; c1/c2/c3 route its deep links to honest cross-concept receipts. Canon impact: a commands manager surface plus keybinding storage (user overrides vs defaults) would need owner docs in Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md and settings inventory placement under extensions.

cross_concept_findings.finding: Six additional packet-derived settings minted during the compliance pass
cross_concept_findings.detail: planning.goal.reserve-policy, branching.worktrees.provisioning, branching.worktrees.port-collision, memory.assembly.parent-handoff, memory.assembly.warn-route-change, general.writing.grammar-assist (separate off-by-default provider-disclosed grammar/style boundary). All src packet-2026-08-05; need minted canonical inventory ids before promotion (total minted now 29).

cross_concept_findings.finding: Language servers manager built; MCP manager completed (recorded-item resolution round)
cross_concept_findings.detail: The formerly unclaimed LSP manager is now built as c1 Appendix D covering the full packet 04 list (states, coverage, executable/version, scope, startup, capabilities, conflicts, formatting/diagnostics ownership, restart/install/logs); other concepts route deep links to cross-concept receipts. MCP gained discovered resources/templates, extensions, discovery-cache freshness, provider/CLI projection notes, and an add-a-server receipt flow. c3 description clamps and c4 value-chip ellipses were removed so no required text truncates. Canon impact: LSP manager surface and MCP resource/extension/cache modeling need owner-doc coverage in Plans/LSPSupport.md and Plans/MCP_Integration.md before promotion.
